probe.method: 4K output scaled to 1280x720 (flags=area) and compared per frame with ffmpeg ssim/psnr against the matching R79 frames; renders in scratchpad only
probe.blocker: Default (non-streaming) 4K capture needs ~75 GB temp for S20; host has ~11 GB free, so --low-memory-mode (streaming, 1 worker, screenshot capture) is required or free disk.

below_4k_sources: S15 ChatGPT capture: raw 3840x1946 VFR window recording; used window 2000x1036 raw px -> 1.82x upscale into 4K capture box (3648x1890)
S16 Sheets capture: raw 3840x1946 VFR; used window 1100x570 raw px -> 3.32x upscale into 4K box (worst leaf in range)
S17 C presenter: generated at 1920x1080 (Higgsfield seedance_2_5 '1080p') + fal sync-lipsync v3 restoration at 1080p 8-bit -> 2x upscale
global_flags_s15_s18.version_drift: r60/r61/r62/r63 plate projects pin hyperframes@0.8.36 (package.json only, no render log); R78 wrappers pin/render 0.8.50; R77 README proposed 0.8.46 (R77 verification says 0.8.50). R78 wrapper is 1280x720-hardcoded px CSS (1216x630 box at 32,60).
ffmpeg_only_effects: R77: crop + fps=24 VFR->CFR resample of screen recordings (frame dup/drop), crf16 re-encode
R78: per-frame linear pan crop (even-truncated) + Lanczos scale to 1216x630 — must be re-expressed at 4K (e.g. crop same raw window, scale to 3648x1890) or moved into HyperFrames
R78 S15 seam-hold PNG and S16 return-still PNG are ffmpeg-extracted frames of the 720p plates (must be re-extracted from 4K plate renders)
S17: presenter trim [8,200) + scale 1920x1080->1280x720; fal lip-sync (provider-side)
r76/r63 context concats and R79 trims: lossy re-encodes only
missing_records: render logs/version-check for r60-r63 plate projects
global_flags_s15_s18.stale_pending_overrides: SEGMENTS.json pending_overrides for S15/S16 (clip null) predate R78; superseded by r78-owner-s15-s16-mobile-lock-v1 which pins the exact R78 mp4 hashes used in segments[].

upstream_sources.role: Seedance 2.5 omni_reference 1080p native take (Higgsfield); no lip-synced mouth
native.mp4 frames [16,337) re-encoded to h264 8-bit; the Sync v3 input; frame-identical timing to restored.mp4

leaves.processing_recipe: restored.mp4 frames [1,319) (= native.mp4 frames [17,335), since native-trim = native[16:] and Sync v3 preserves frame count/timing) -> scale=1280:720 (plain full-frame downscale 1920x1080->1280x720, no crop/pad, ffmpeg default bicubic assumed), no fps change (24->24), no color ops, no overlays -> libx264 yuv420p = r59-s14-presenter/qa/s14-a.mp4 (318 frames; PSNR vs scaled restored 50-52 dB at start 1, ~33-38 dB at +-1). Restored clip audio (Sync placement 2000 samples, picture-minus-audio 0.0 ms) was used only for alignment; context and R79 audio are master PCM, so the audio offset does not affect picture. Downstream of the part clip (all verified numerically): part clip concatenated with no transition/overlay into r59-s14-full-context/qa/context.mp4 (libx264 1280x720 24fps yuv420p bt709; S13 tail is frames [0,192)); build_r79 then trims context [192,1962) with no scaling. Context-vs-part-clip PSNR 50-66 dB on every frame; shifting by 1 frame drops to ~9.6 dB, so boundaries are exact. No script that built context.mp4 exists in the repo; recipe reconstructed and verified by PSNR.
leaves.notes: FLAG: presenter is 1080p at every stage (Seedance native 1920x1080 10-bit; Sync v3 lip-sync output 1920x1080 8-bit). No 4K source exists; a true 4K presenter is impossible without upscaling restored.mp4 (2x) or paid regeneration + new Sync run + owner re-approval. Use restored.mp4, not native.mp4: native lacks the lip-synced mouth (restored vs native-trim PSNR ~44 dB, differences in mouth region). native.mp4 is 10-bit but only useful for non-mouth regions. Owner accepted body drift (up to ~0.3-0.4 s early at start) in A and C3. Sync v3 output is external (Fal); re-running it would not be deterministic.
